decisions.question: Which document is the approved policy, and what are its version, approval date and effective date? Which sections impose controls on the process?

Which country/jurisdiction applies, and are any of the policy's requirements statutory? If so, which instrument, article and status (in force, amended, repealed)? Without this the review is limited to company policy and legal validity stays unverified.

Which workflow design is the target of the mapping: a manifest and workflow.yaml placed in the working directory, or a live workflow (name/id) exported through the Provia connector in an authorized session?

Which three incidents, and what records will be supplied for each (case export with action status, assignee and completion timestamps; comments; attachment list; decision outcomes; workflow version the incident ran on)?
Confirm the country of operation and the response language. Angola and English were used provisionally on 2026-09-21 because the request stated neither.
